title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials urge residents to keep pets out of Ames Pond following a dog's death linked to suspected algae bloom.
Algae blooms, consisting of cyanobacteria, can be harmful to humans and deadly to pets, according to town officials.
Weekly E. Coli tests at Ames Pond show no issues, but algae bloom remains a potential cause of water safety concerns.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Former NH trooper James Lamoureux admitted to false reporting about GPS devices tracking his girlfriend.
Lamoureux faces a suspended six-month prison sentence under a negotiated court resolution.
He will resign and be placed on the national registry of decertified officers, barring future law enforcement work.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to a report of a man with a gun at Grace Chapel, prompting a lockdown.
The man was found polishing a powder horn, explaining he was an avid period reenactor awaiting his wife.
Police confirmed no threat was present, and Worthen Road was temporarily closed due to the heavy response.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox are in strong position for A.L.'s second wild-card spot with 64-52 record.
Rob Parker believes Red Sox will miss playoffs despite recent winning streaks and high playoff odds.
FanGraphs estimates 96% playoff chance for Red Sox, with 83.4% for wild-card and 12.6% for division win.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was scratched from Saturday's Red Sox lineup due to leg swelling after being hit in Friday's game.
Manager Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return to the lineup on Sunday after receiving treatment.
Abreu, a key offensive player, has 20 home runs, 62 RBIs, a .256 average, and .793 OPS this season.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics on Saturday evening.
Starting pitcher Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs over 5.1 innings against the Athletics.
The Red Sox maintain a nine series winning streak and hold the second American League wild-card spot.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf again due to an unmet NFL laboratory testing protocol.
The stadium's current turf met performance standards but lacked required NFL compliance due to absence of an 'E-layer'.
The NFL denied an updated testing request, requiring the turf used in 2025 to be reinstalled.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium on Saturday.
Jack Harrison made his club debut in the 55th minute but couldn't impact the game's result.
Guilherme and Agustin Resch scored for Houston, capitalizing on New England's defensive lapses.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony is training with a pitching machine as he recovers from a wrist injury since May.
Adley Rutschman made a rehab appearance for the Worcester Red Sox, progressing towards a return after a July injury.
Boston Red Sox continue a 9-game winning streak, with potential boosts from Anthony's and Rutschman's returns.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'Clueless', 'Eighth Grade', and 'Something's Gotta Give' are top recommended films streaming on Netflix in August 2026.
'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' and 'The Ballad of Wallis Island' are new releases on Paramount+ and Peacock, respectively.
Staff recommend 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds', 'Ted Lasso', and 'Voicemails for Isabelle' on various streaming platforms.
